forbidden.any target residual: must not be used to edit this solver output after validation

grid_required.points: strictly increasing list from 0 to L

solver_metadata_required.mesh_points: integer number of axial grid points exported
solver_metadata_required.nonlinear_residual_norm: finite nonnegative frozen solver residual norm
solver_metadata_required.source_commit: solver source revision, fixture-only tag, or equivalent provenance id
